page.text:
The set of integers is then the quotient of the pairs of naturals by this
relation. Each integer is an equivalence class of differences, so that
$2 - 5$ and $0 - 3$ name the same integer, written $-3$. With
$\mathbb{Z}$ in hand, subtraction becomes total and the arithmetic of the
naturals extends to negative numbers.
